followup_proposals.title: Run the viva-cpm CPM composite end-to-end
followup_proposals.motivation: The sourcing decision (reuse viva-cpm) is audited PASS, but the run is audit-only: the Rust/maturin CPM composite needs its own core registration and lattice/energy parameters to execute. This follow-up makes the Cellular Potts shape dynamics actually run, so the reuse decision is demonstrated rather than only audited.

purpose.question: Does the reuse-viva-cpm decision hold up when the CPM composite is actually run to completion?
purpose.mechanism: Register a cpm-specific core, supply lattice + surface-energy/adhesion params, and run the shape-dynamics composite.
purpose.expected_outcome: A cell changes shape on the lattice as surface energy/adhesion evolve; the run completes and shape-dynamics source_fit becomes demonstrated.

followup_proposals.resolution: Closed in-place: build_core now inherits viva-cpm's CPMProcess into the shared workspace core (inherit_reused_modules), so a minimal Cellular Potts composite runs on it. shape-dynamics now executes for real — two cells relax from 36px seed blocks toward target volume 80 (69, 72) under the Metropolis Hamiltonian — instead of audit-only.
